history.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
history.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

history.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
history.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 88.6% (sc:70610@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

history.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
history.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate the increased volume forecast and your willingness to commit to a 36-month contract. While we acknowledge the delivery metric and are actively optimizing our logistics, your target price is significantly below our capabilities.

We can offer €5.56 per unit under your proposed terms of 60 days payment and a 36-month contract. Thus, our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 5 days. With overtime we can deliver in 5 days, at a premium.
